title: Talking about past experiences / Kozonga yango mpo na bangomba ya mokolo na mokolo
bridge: Na espanyol, mpo na kozonga yango mpo na bangomba ya mokolo na mokolo, tosilanga pretérito perfecto compuesto ('he visitado') to pretérito indefinido ('visité'), lokola ete mokolo oyo ezali kosalema na ntango ya lelo to te. Na anglais, mpo na bangomba ya bomoi, tosilanga 'present perfect' ('have visited'), oyo azali na motindo moko te na espanyol. Mokolo oyo ezali ya mpenza ete na anglais tosilanga 'have + participio' mpo na mikakatano oyo ezali na ntango moko te, ndenge oyo na espanyol tosilanga mingi pretérito indefinido mpo na mikakatano oyo ezali na mokolo moko ya mpenza. Boye: na anglais, tokoki kotosa 'present perfect' na bangomba ya ntango ya mokolo oyo ya mpenza lokola 'yesterday' to 'last year'.
rule: Mpo na kozonga yango mpo na bangomba ya mokolo na mokolo na anglais, tosilanga 'present perfect' na motindo oyo: have/has + participio ya mokolo. Tosilanga yango mpo na: 1) bangomba ya bomoi na kozonga yango mokolo moko te (I have visited Paris), 2) mikakatano oyo salemi na mokolo na mokolo na ezali na bosembo na lelo (She has lost her keys), 3) na bangomba lokola 'ever', 'never', 'already', 'yet', 'just', 'before'. Motindo ya ngala ezali na 'have not' (haven't) to 'has not' (hasn't). Mpo na kozonga yango na ngala, tokokisa lisusu motindo ya mposa (Have you ever...?). Mpo na kozonga yango mpo na bangomba, tosilanga 'Have you ever + participio?' na tokombola na 'Yes, I have' to 'No, I never have'. Tosilanga 'present perfect' na bangomba ya ntango ya mokolo oyo ya mpenza (yesterday, last week, in 2010). Na bangomba oyo, tosilanga 'past simple' (visited, went). Mpo na A2, ezali ya mpenza koteya bangomba ya participio ya bangomba ya mawa (go-gone, eat-eaten, see-seen, have-had).

concept_examples.text: I have visited Mexico.
She has never eaten sushi.
Have you ever seen that movie?
We have already finished our homework.
concept_examples.translation: Tokomi yango na biso lisolo na biso.

common_error.explanation: Likolo oyo ezali mpo na espanyol tokoki koloba 'He visitado París ayer' na bangomba ya ntango ya mokolo oyo ya mpenza, kasi na anglais 'present perfect' ezali na bangomba ya ntango ya mokolo oyo ya mpenza lokola 'yesterday'. Mpo na ntango moko ya mpenza na mokolo, tokoki kotosa 'past simple' (visited). Soki tokoki kozonga yango mokolo moko te, tosilanga 'present perfect' (have visited). Boye: 'present perfect' + ntango ya mpenza = malamu te.

levels.label: Present Perfect with 'ever' and 'never'
levels.translation: Present Perfect na 'ever' na 'never'

examples.original: Have you ever been to London?
examples.translation: Ozali komonana Londres?
examples.note: Tosilanga 'ever' na botiki mpo na kozonga yango mpo na bangomba na ntango nionso ya bomoi.

examples.original: I have never tried Thai food.
examples.translation: Nazali te kosala mangembo ya Thai.
examples.note: 'Never' ezali na 'have' na participio, na elobeli 'jamais' na bomoi.

examples.original: She has never flown in a plane.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi hæz ˈnɛvər floʊn ɪn ə pleɪn/
examples.translation: Ye azali te kobima na avion.
examples.note: Boyebi ete 'flown' ezali participio ya 'fly', motindo ya mawa.

levels.label: Present Perfect with 'already' and 'yet'
levels.translation: Present Perfect na 'already' na 'yet'

examples.translation: Nazali yango na petit déjeuner.
examples.note: 'Already' tosilanga na elobeli na elobeli 'déjà' (na ntango ya mpenza).'

examples.original: Have you bought the tickets yet?
examples.translation: Ozali yango na biliete?
examples.note: 'Yet' tosilanga na botiki na ngala, na nsuka ya elobeli, na elobeli 'encore/toujours'.

examples.original: We haven't finished our project yet.
examples.translation: Tokomi yango te na biso projet na biso.
examples.note: Na ngala, 'yet' ezali na nsuka na elobeli ete likambo oyo salemi te kino.

levels.label: Past Simple vs. Present Perfect
levels.translation: Pasado Simple vs. Present Perfect

examples.translation: Nazali komonana Pérou (na ntango nionso ya bomoi).
examples.note: 'Present perfect' tosilanga na ntango moko te, mpo na bangomba.

examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɛnt tə pəˈruː ɪn tuː ˈθaʊzənd nɪnˈtiːn/
examples.translation: Nazali komonana Pérou na 2019.
examples.note: 'Past simple' tosilanga na bangomba ya ntango ya mokolo oyo ya mpenza, lokola 'na 2019'.

examples.original: She has lived in Madrid for two years.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi hæz lɪvd ɪn məˈdrɪd fɔːr tuː jɪrz/
examples.translation: Ye azali na Madrid mpo na mbula mibili.
examples.note: 'Present perfect' tosilanga na 'for' + ntango mpo na kozonga yango mikakatano oyo ezali na bomoi na lelo.

examples.translation: Ye amoni ndeko na ye na mokolo.
examples.note: Na pasado simple, motindo 'see' ezali 'saw', na tosilanga na ntango ya mpenza.

translations.ln: Kozonga yango mpo na bangomba ya mokolo na mokolo

title: Making Plans and Arrangements / Koba mobalɛ na kosala rendez-vous
bridge: Na espanyole, tosilaka verbes au présent de l'indicatif tola au futur périphrastique (ir a + infinitif) mpo na kosala mobalɛ. Na anglais, mpo na mobalɛ na rendez-vous, basili kolanda 'present continuous' (I'm meeting) mpo na mobalɛ oyo ezali déjà fixé, na 'be going to' (I'm going to visit) mpo na makasi. Boye, na anglais basili kosala ba présent simple mpo na ba futurs personnels, boye na espanyole (p. ex. 'Te llamo mañana' → 'I'll call you tomorrow', kasi 'I call you'). Kasi, 'will' basili kosala mpo na ba décisions spontané, kasi mpo na mobalɛ oyo déjà ezali.
rule:
Mpo na kosala mobalɛ na rendez-vous na anglais niveau A2, silaka ba structures oyo:

1. **Present continuous** (am/is/are + -ing): mpo na mobalɛ na rendez-vous oyo déjà ezali fixé, na l'heure na lieu. P. ex. 'I'm seeing the doctor at 3.' (Nazali déjà kosala rendez-vous).

2. **Be going to** (am/is/are going to + infinitif): mpo na makasi tola mobalɛ oyo azali na ba détails oyo kokolake te. P. ex. 'We're going to visit our grandparents.' (Nazali na makasi).

3. **Will** (will + verbe base): mpo na ba décisions oyo tozali kosala na mokolo oyo tozali kozonga, ba offres tola ba promesses. P. ex. 'I'll help you with that.' (Décision spontané).

4. **Would like to** (would like to + infinitif): mpo na ba invitations tola mobalɛ oyo ezali plus formel tola plus poli. P. ex. 'Would you like to come to my party?'

Boyei, na anglais basili kosala ba présent simple mpo na ba futurs personnels (kasi espanyole na ba contexte mosusu). Silaka toujours 'be going to' tola 'present continuous' mpo na mobalɛ.

concept_examples.text: I'm meeting my friend at the cinema tonight.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali kosala rendez-vous na mon ami na cinéma cette nuit.
concept_examples.phonetic: aɪm ˈmiːtɪŋ maɪ frend æt ðə ˈsɪnəmə təˈnaɪt

concept_examples.text: We're going to travel to Spain next summer.
concept_examples.translation: Tozali koluka kopesa Espagne l'été oyo ezali kolanda.
concept_examples.phonetic: wɪər ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə ˈtrævəl tə speɪn nekst ˈsʌmər

concept_examples.text: I'll help you with your homework after class.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali koyoka yokota na ba devoirs na yo sima ya cours.
concept_examples.phonetic: aɪl help juː wɪð jɔːr ˈhəʊmwɜːrk ˈɑːftər klɑːs

concept_examples.text: Would you like to come to my birthday party?
concept_examples.translation: Oyebi kozonga na fête ya anniversaire ya ngai?
concept_examples.phonetic: wʊd juː laɪk tə kʌm tə maɪ ˈbɜːrθdeɪ ˈpɑːrti

common_error.wrong: I meet my friend at the cinema tonight.
common_error.correct: I'm meeting my friend at the cinema tonight.
common_error.correct_alt: I'm going to meet my friend at the cinema tonight.
common_error.explanation: Erreur ezali mpo na espanyole tosilaka 'Quedo con mi amigo' na présent simple mpo na un plan futur. Na anglais, présent simple esili kokoki kosala ba futurs personnels; mpo na mobalɛ oyo déjà ezali fixé, silaka présent continu (I'm meeting) tola 'be going to' (I'm going to meet).

levels.label: Expressing Future Plans with 'going to'
levels.translation: Kobenga ba plans futurs na 'going to'

examples.original: I'm going to visit my grandma this weekend.
examples.phonetic: aɪm ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə ˈvɪzɪt maɪ ˈɡrændmɑː ðɪs wiːkˈend
examples.translation: Nazali koluka kopesa grand-mère ya ngai week-end oyo ezali kolanda.
examples.note: Tosili 'be going to' + infinitif mpo na ba makasi tola ba plans généraux. Na espanyole ezali 'ir a + infinitivo'.

examples.original: She's going to start a new job in June.
examples.phonetic: ʃiːz ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə stɑːrt ə njuː dʒɒb ɪn dʒuːn
examples.translation: Yande azali koluka kotambola travail ya sika na mois ya juin.
examples.note: Boyei, 'going to' ekokaki te na personne, kasi verbe 'be' (is, am, are) nde ekokaki.

levels.label: Making Fixed Arrangements with Present Continuous
levels.translation: Kosala ba rendez-vous oyo déjà ezali fixé na présent continu

examples.original: I'm seeing the dentist at 4:30 tomorrow.
examples.phonetic: aɪm ˈsiːɪŋ ðə ˈdentɪst æt fɔː θɜːrti təˈmɒroʊ
examples.translation: Nazali koluka kopesa dentiste demain na 4:30.
examples.note: Présent continu esalaka ndenge oyo rendez-vous ezali déjà fixé. Na espanyole tosilaka 'voy' tola 'tengo cita'.

examples.original: We're having dinner with the Smiths on Friday.
examples.phonetic: wɪər ˈhævɪŋ ˈdɪnər wɪð ðə smɪθs ɒn ˈfraɪdeɪ
examples.translation: Tozali kolya na ba Smith vendredi.
examples.note: Mpo na ba accords na heure na lieu oyo déjà ezali fixé, présent continu ezali forme ya naturel na anglais.

levels.label: Inviting and Responding to Suggestions
levels.translation: Kobenga na kosala ba suggestions

examples.original: Would you like to join us for lunch?
examples.phonetic: wʊd juː laɪk tə dʒɔɪn ʌs fɔːr lʌntʃ
examples.translation: Oyebi kozonga na biso mpo na mangembo?
examples.note: Tosili 'would like to' mpo na ba invitations oyo ezali poli. Na espanyole: '¿Te gustaría...?'

examples.original: Sure, I'd love to. What time?
examples.phonetic: ʃʊr aɪd lʌv tə wɒt taɪm
examples.translation: Eh, nazali na makasi. L'heure nini?
examples.note: Réponse ya positif oyo ezali classique. 'I'd love to' ezali contraction ya 'I would love to'.

examples.original: Sorry, I can't. I have another appointment.
examples.phonetic: ˈsɒri aɪ kænt aɪ hæv əˈnʌðər əˈpɔɪntmənt
examples.translation: Nazali na regret, nazali koyoka te. Nazali na rendez-vous mosusu.
examples.note: Mpo na kobenga na ndenge oyo ezali poli, pesa raison ya court. Sila 'can't' na place ya 'cannot' na conversation.

title: Giving advice and recommendations / Koyá yango na kozwela
bridge: Na espanyol, po na kozwela tokolí na subjonctif (te recomiendo que vayas, deberías ir). Kasi na anglais, subjonctif azali kosalelwa mpenza na sima ya 'recommend' to 'suggest'; tokolí na ntina moko mpe na infinitif: 'I recommend you go', 'I suggest you try'. Tokosala mpe na 'should' (deberías) oyo ezali pete mpenza na sima ya 'must'. Likambo oyo ezali kozala na ntina moko mpe na subjonctif ya espanyol: 'I recommend that you go' ezali ya solo, kasi 'I recommend you to go' ezali likambo oyo ezali kozala na ntina moko mpe na infinitif ya 'to' kasi na anglais 'recommend' azali kosalelwa na sima ya infinitif ya 'to' soki azali na objet.
rule:
Po na kozwela na yango na anglais na niveau A2, salá na bango yango na ntina moko:
1. **Should / Shouldn't + verbe base**: po na kozwela ya ndenge nionso. Ex: 'You should eat more vegetables.' 'You shouldn't stay up late.' (ntina ya solo). Azali kosalelwa te (he should, no he shoulds).
2. **You could + verbe base**: po na kozwela ya pete mpenza to bangola. Ex: 'You could try yoga.'
3. **I recommend / I suggest + that + sujet + verbe base** (na 'to' mpe na subjonctif ya terminaison). Ex: 'I recommend that you see a doctor.' Tokosala mpe na gerundif: 'I recommend seeing a doctor.' to 'I suggest trying this.'
4. **How about + gerundif (-ing)?**: po na kozwela ya kati. Ex: 'How about going for a walk?'
5. **Why don't you + verbe base?**: po na kozwela na ntina ya soló. Ex: 'Why don't you take a break?'
Note: salá 'must' po na kozwela, ezali ya solo mpenza; 'must' ezali obligation. Po na kozwela ya pete mpenza, salá 'could' to 'might'. Kofinga ete na sima ya 'recommend' na 'suggest', tosalelwa 'to' na sima ya objet: 'I recommend you to go' ezali ya solo.

concept_examples.text: You should drink more water.
I recommend that you talk to the teacher.
concept_examples.translation: Nakoyá yango na kozwela na yo kozwa na professeur.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˌrekəˈmend ðæt juː tɔːk tə ðə ˈtiːtʃər/

concept_examples.text: Why don't you try it?
How about studying with us?
concept_examples.translation: Ndenge nini tozali koyekola na biso?

common_error.wrong: I recommend you to go to the doctor.
common_error.correct: I recommend that you go to the doctor.
common_error.correct_alt: I recommend going to the doctor.
common_error.explanation: Na espanyol tokolí 'te recomiendo que vayas' to 'te recomiendo ir', kasi na anglais, na sima ya 'recommend' tosalelwa te infinitif na 'to' na sima ya objet. Ntina ya solo ezali 'recommend + that + sujet + verbe base' to 'recommend + gerundif'. Likambo oyo ezali kozala na ntina moko mpe na infinitif ya 'to' kasi ete bato basali traduction ya solo 'te recomiendo a ti ir' (oyo ezali kozala na ntina moko mpe na 'recommend you to go'). Po na kozala na likambo oyo, kofinga ete: 'recommend' azali kosalelwa na 'that' to na '-ing', mpe na 'to' mpe.

levels.label: Basic advice with should
levels.translation: Kozwela ya ntango nionso na should

examples.translation: Ozali koyeba mpenza nsisi.
examples.note: Sala 'should' + verbe base. Na espanyol, 'deberías' + infinitif.

examples.original: He shouldn't eat so much sugar.
examples.translation: Ye azali koyeba mpenza sukali mpenza.
examples.note: Ntina ya solo ezali 'shouldn't' + verbe base. Azali kosalelwa te po na troisième personne.

examples.original: We should study for the test.
examples.translation: Tozali koyeba mpenza po na examen.
examples.note: 'Should' azali kosalelwa te na ntina ya personne: I should, you should, we should.

levels.label: Suggestions with could and how about
levels.translation: Kozwela na could na how about

examples.original: You could try the new restaurant.
examples.translation: Ozali koyeba mpenza restaurant ya sika.
examples.note: 'Could' ezali kozwela ya pete mpenza, ezali pete mpenza na sima ya 'should'.

examples.original: How about going to the park?
examples.translation: Ndenge nini tozali koyekola na parc?
examples.note: Na sima ya 'How about' tosalelwa gerundif (-ing).

examples.translation: Tozali koyeba mpenza kosala yango na ntango ya zola?
examples.note: Tokosala mpe 'could' na soló po na kozwela ya pete mpenza.

levels.label: Formal recommendations with recommend and suggest
levels.translation: Kozwela ya solo na recommend na suggest

examples.original: I suggest that you take a break.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ səˈdʒest ðæt juː teɪk ə breɪk/
examples.translation: Nakoyá yango na kozwela na yo kozwa na repos.
examples.note: Sala 'that + sujet + verbe base' (na 'to' mpe na subjonctif ya terminaison).

examples.original: They recommend staying at the hotel.
examples.translation: Basali yango na kozwela na bango kozala na hôtel.
examples.note: Na gerundif soki azali na sujet ya solo.

examples.original: The teacher suggested that we practice every day.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈtiːtʃər səˈdʒestɪd ðæt wiː ˈpræktɪs ˈɛvri deɪ/
examples.translation: Professeur asali yango na kozwela na bango kozala na pratique na bango na ndenge nionso.
examples.note: Na passé na 'that' + verbe base (sala 'practiced'). Likambo oyo ezali ya solo.

title: Expressing opinions / Komona boyokani (nakoki, nalukuta)
bridge: Na espanyolí, tokosala 'creo que' mpe 'pienso que' na ntina moko, kasi na ngala, kaka mbeke: 'I think' ezali ya ndakisa mpe tokosala yango na boyokani mpe makasi, mpe 'I believe' ekomisa bokomi ya makasi to ya motoya. Molongo moko ezali kopesa 'Yo pienso que' kaka 'I think that', kasi na ngala, 'that' ezali ya kobima te mpe tokoyoka yango mingi. Mpe na ngala, esika ezali ntina ya komona sujet + verbe + complément, ezali na bosungi ya kopesa préposition moko kaka 'en' to 'de'. Koluka kozala na likolo ya maboko ya bazo mpe koyoka 'that' na bosungi te.
rule:
Na kosala boyokani na ngala na niveau A2, tokosala esika oyo:
- 'I think (that) + phrase' – na boyokani mpe makasi ya ndakisa.
- 'I believe (that) + phrase' – na boyebi to bokomi ya motoya.
- 'In my opinion, + phrase' – ya makasi, kasi ezali na bokasi na yambo.
Maboko moko: 'I guess' (nakoki) mpe 'I suppose' (nalukuta), mibali mibali.
Boyebi: 'that' ezali ya kobima te mpe tokoyoka yango mingi na kozanga. Esika ezali ntina ya komona sujet + verbe + complément. Koya 'of' to 'on' na nse ya 'think/believe' te. Tokoti 'I think in that' te, kasi 'I think that' to 'I think'. Ndakisa: 'I think (that) it's a good idea', 'I believe (that) he is right'. Na nzela ya kozanga, tokoki koyoka 'do you think?' na nsuka: 'It's a good idea, do you think?'

concept_examples.text: I think it's going to rain.
I believe you are right.
In my opinion, this movie is great.
concept_examples.translation: Na boyokani na ngai, film oyo ezali malamu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən ðɪs ˈmuːvi ɪz ɡreɪt/

concept_examples.text: I guess we can try again.

common_error.wrong: I think in that it is good.
common_error.correct: I think that it is good.
common_error.explanation: Molongo ezali na kopesa ya ntina 'pienso en que', esika préposition 'en' ekomi na ngala. Na ngala, maboko 'think' mpe 'believe' ezali na préposition te na nse ya complément. Koyeka kopesa 'in' to 'on'. Mpe 'that' ezali ya kobima te, kasi koyoka 'I think it is good' ezali ya ndakisa mpe ezali na bokasi mingi na kozanga.

levels.label: Basic opinions with I think
levels.translation: Boyokani ya ndakisa na I think

examples.translation: Nakoki ngala ezali ya sika.
examples.note: Kosa 'I think' + phrase na 'that' te na yambo ya kozanga.

examples.translation: Nakoki ye azali malamu.
examples.note: Boyebi: koyoka 'that' na bosungi te.

examples.translation: Nakoki tokoki kozala na mbula.
examples.note: Verbe 'be' ekomisa sujet: I am, you are, we are.

levels.label: Stronger opinions with I believe
levels.translation: Boyokani ya makasi na I believe

examples.translation: Nalukuta na likambo ya kosala na makasi.
examples.note: Kwa 'believe in' ekomisa koyoka na likambo moko, kasi na boyokani tokosala 'believe that'.

examples.original: I believe that he is honest.
examples.translation: Nakoki ye azali ya bosembo.
examples.note: Kwa 'that' ezali ya kobima te mpe ekomisa ya makasi.

examples.original: I believe this is the best option.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ bɪˈliːv ðɪs ɪz ðə bɛst ˈɒpʃən/
examples.translation: Nakoki oyo ezali ndakisa ya malamu.
examples.note: Kosa 'this' na likambo oyo ezali na pewe; 'that' na likambo oyo ezali na ngwa.

levels.label: Giving opinions and asking others
levels.translation: Komona boyokani mpe kozanga basusu

examples.original: In my opinion, the food is delicious.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən ðə fuːd ɪz dɪˈlɪʃəs/
examples.translation: Na boyokani na ngai, mbisi ezali malamu.
examples.note: Komona oyo ezali ya makasi mpe tokosala yango na nsuka ya phrase, na nse ya coma.

examples.original: What do you think about this plan?
examples.phonetic: /wɒt duː juː θɪŋk əˈbaʊt ðɪs plæn/
examples.translation: Oyebi nini na ntina ya esika oyo?
examples.note: Na kozanga boyokani, kosa 'What do you think about...?'

examples.translation: Nalukuta ezali malamu.
examples.note: 'I guess' ezali ya mibali mpe ekomisa bokomi to makasi.

title: Agreeing and Disagreeing / Koteza na kozonga
bridge: Na espanyol, po na koteza tozali koyeba 'estoy de acuerdo', mpe po na kozonga 'no estoy de acuerdo', kasi na anglais bazali kosenga biloko oyo ezali makasi mpe na bosembo lokola 'I agree' mpe 'I disagree'. Mpe ezali na ntina kozanga 'so do I' mpe 'neither do I' po na komonisa ete tozali koteza na likambo moko ya solo mpe ya se, likambo oyo ezali na mokolo moko te na espanyol mpe ezali kobengaka. Kolinga ete 'agree' ezali dongola, ezali dongola te, kasi ozonga te 'I am agree', kasi 'I agree'.
rule: Po na kozonga na anglais tozali kozanga 'I agree' (nazali koteza) to 'I think so' (nazali kolinga ete solo). Po na kozonga, 'I disagree' (nazali kozonga) to 'I don't think so' (nazali kolinga ete se). Po na komonisa ete tozali koteza na likambo moko ya solo, tozali kozanga 'So do I' (nazali koteza mpe na nyonso) to 'Me too' (nazali koteza mpe na nyonso). Po na koteza na likambo moko ya se, tozali kozanga 'Neither do I' (nazali kozonga mpe na nyonso) to 'Me neither' (nazali kozonga mpe na nyonso). Mpe tozali kozanga 'Exactly' (ntina) to 'That's right' (ezali solo) po na kozonga makasi, mpe 'I'm not sure' (nazali kozonga te) po na kozonga ya bosembo. Kolinga ete 'agree' ezali dongola ya solo: I agree, you agree, he/she agrees. Po na kozonga molongo, tozali kozanga 'Do you agree?' (ozali koteza?).

concept_examples.text: I agree with you.
I disagree with that idea.
So do I.
Neither do I.

common_error.explanation: Likolo ezali kozala mpo na espanyol 'estar de acuerdo' ezali kozanga dongola 'estar' + nkombo, mpe bato bazali koyekola yango na bosembo lokola 'I am agree'. Na anglais, 'agree' ezali dongola, mpo na kozonga te 'to be'. Po na kozala na yango, kolinga ete 'agree' ezali bosungi, ezali etat te. Kosala lisolo na biloko lokola 'I agree' to 'I don't agree'.

levels.label: Basic Agreement and Disagreement

examples.translation: Nazali koteza mpe na nyonso.
examples.note: Nkobala moke mpe ya bosembo po na biloko ya solo.

examples.translation: Nazali kozonga mpe na nyonso.

title: Describing Daily Routines / Kozonga makambo oyo tokolisaka yango mobimba
bridge: Na espanyolí, tokosala 'yo me levanto' to 'me levanto' na kosala ba verbes oyo tokosala yango na mbongo. Na nguma, tokoyoka mbongo mpo na kozonga: kaka 'I get up'. Kasi, na espanyolí, tokoyoka mbongo mingi na kosala sujet ('desayuno'), kasi na nguma, tokoyoka mbongo 'I' ('I have breakfast'). Kasi, na nguma, mpo na makambo oyo tokolisaka, tokosala présent simple na -s na ba personnes oyo ezali na mbongo ('he gets up'), mpe ba adverbes oyo tokolisaka ('always', 'usually') tozali kozonga na mboka ya verbe, kaka na espanyolí ('siempre me levanto' vs. 'I always get up').
rule: Mpo na kozonga makambo oyo tokolisaka na nguma, tokosala présent simple (present simple). Structure ezali: Sujet + verbe (na -s mpo na he/she/it) + complément. Ba adverbes oyo tokolisaka (always, usually, often, sometimes, never) tozali kozonga na mboka ya verbe principal, kasi na nsuka ya verbe 'to be'. Ba expressions oyo tokolisaka makambo oyo tokolisaka 'in the morning', 'at night' tozali kozonga na mboka to na nsuka ya phrase. Koyeba ete na nguma, tokoki kozonga sujet.

concept_examples.text: I wake up at six every morning.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ weɪk ʌp æt sɪks ˈɛvri ˈmɔrnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: She usually takes a shower in the evening.
concept_examples.translation: Yaye azali kosala douche na ntango ya soir.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi ˈjuʒuəli teɪks ə ˈʃaʊər ɪn ðə ˈivnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: We have breakfast together at home.
They always go to bed at eleven.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈɔlweɪz goʊ tu bɛd æt ɪˈlɛvən/

common_error.explanation: Ba erreurs oyo tokolisaka mingi ezali kozonga -s na ba personnes oyo ezali na mbongo. Na espanyolí, conjugaison echengi ('se despierta'), kasi na nguma, tokoyoka kaka -s to -es. Kasi erreur moko ezali kozonga sujet ('Wakes up'), kasi na nguma, tokoyoka mbongo. Mpo na kozala na yango, koyeba ete: na he/she/it, tokoyoka kaka -s na verbe.

levels.label: Morning Routine

examples.note: Na he/she/it, verbe 'watch' echengi na 'watches'

title: Talking about health and symptoms / Kozonga ntoma na makila
bridge: Na espanyol, tozali kozonga ntoma na makila na kozala na verbu 'tener': 'tengo dolor de cabeza', 'tengo fiebre'. Kasi na anglais, structure ezali mosusu: tozali kozala na 'have' ('I have a headache') mpo na makila mpe 'feel' mpo na makila oyo tozali kozala na yango ('I feel sick'). Molongo moko ezali kozwa 'I have cold' na nzela ya 'I have a cold', mpo na anglais, makila lokola 'cold' to 'headache' tozali kobenga na ngambo ya ntalo ('a'). Mpe, boya motema na yango ete 'ache' tozali kozala na yango lokola se oyo ezali na bosongi bosusu: 'headache', 'toothache', kasi 'pain' mpo na makila oyo ezali koleka na bato nionso. Bandakisa yango ezali mibeko ya ntina mpo kozwa lokola moto oyo azali kozala na yango.
rule:
Mpo kozonga ntoma na makila na anglais na niveau A2, kozala na bango yango:

1. **Have + makila:** Kozala na 'have' (kasi te 'tener' ya solo) na makila oyo ezali na ntalo: 'I have a cold' (nazali na makila ya nzoto), 'I have a headache' (nazali na makila ya tete), 'I have a toothache' (nazali na makila ya zonga). Boya motema na yango ete kozala na ngambo 'a' liboso ya bango yango.

2. **Feel + ngambo:** Mpo kozwa makila, kozala na 'feel' + ngambo: 'I feel tired' (nazali na makila ya kopesa), 'I feel sick' (nazali na makila ya maladi), 'I feel dizzy' (nazali na makila ya kopesa).

3. **Makila ya solo:** Soki makila ezali ya solo, kozala na 'I have pain in my back' (nazali na makila na nzoto na ngai) to 'my back hurts' (nzoto na ngai ezali na makila).

4. **Verbu 'hurt':** 'Hurt' tozali kozala na yango mpo kozwa ete oyo ezali na makila: 'My head hurts' (Tete na ngai ezali na makila), 'My stomach hurts' (Nzoto na ngai ezali na makila).

5. **Kozwa ntoma:** Mpo kozwa ntoma ya moto: 'What's wrong?' (Nani ezali na yo?), 'Are you okay?' (Ozali malamu?), 'How do you feel?' (Ozali kozala nangani?).

6. **Mibeko:** Mpo kopesa mibeko, kozala na 'should' to 'shouldn't': 'You should see a doctor' (Ozali koswana kozala na dokita), 'You shouldn't eat that' (Ozali koswana kolya yango).

**Bandakisa na mikakatano mike:**
- 'Cold' (makila ya nzoto) ezali na ntalo mpe kozala na ngambo: 'a cold'.
- 'Flu' (makila ya maladi) mbala moke tozali kozala na yango na bosongi: 'I have the flu' to 'I have flu', kasi 'the flu' ezali mpe ya solo.
- 'Fever' (makila ya maladi) tozali kozala na yango na ngambo: 'I have a fever'.
- 'Sore throat' (makila ya zonga) tozali kozala na yango na ngambo: 'I have a sore throat'.
- Makila moke tozali kozala na yango na bosongi mpo ezali te na ntalo: 'I have a cough' (to 'to cough'), 'I have a runny nose' (to 'I have a runny nose' mpe yango tozali kozala na yango na ngambo).

**Note:** Na anglais, tozali kozala te na 'make' mpo na makila lokola na espanyol ('me duele' = 'it hurts' to 'I have pain').

concept_examples.text: I have a headache.
I feel sick.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali na makila ya maladi to kopesa.

concept_examples.text: My stomach hurts.
concept_examples.translation: Nzoto na ngai ezali na makila.

concept_examples.text: You should see a doctor.

common_error.explanation: Na espanyol tozali kozwa 'tengo frío' to 'tengo un resfriado' na bosongi na mikakatano mike, kasi na anglais 'cold' (makila ya nzoto) ezali na ntalo mpe kozala na ngambo 'a'. 'Have got' ezali mpe ya solo mpe ezali malamu. Mpo kozwa 'tengo frío' (makila ya nzoto), tozali kozwa 'I am cold' to 'I feel cold', kasi te 'I have cold'.

levels.label: Common symptoms
levels.translation: Makila oyo tozali kozala na yango

examples.translation: Nazali na makila ya koyeba.
examples.note: Boya motema na yango ete 'a cough' tozali kozala na yango na ngambo ya ntalo. Na espanyol tozali kozwa 'tengo tos' na bosongi.

examples.translation: Nazali na makila ya maladi.
examples.note: Makila ya maladi tozali kozala na yango na ngambo 'a fever', na ndenge mosusu na espanyol 'tengo fiebre'.

examples.translation: Nazali na makila ya zonga.
examples.note: 'Sore throat' ezali ngambo ya solo. Tozali kozala te na yango 'pain in the throat' na ndenge ya solo.

levels.label: Expressing how you feel
levels.translation: Kozwa ntoma oyo ozali kozala na yango

examples.translation: Nazali na makila ya kopesa.
examples.note: Kozala na 'feel' + ngambo mpo na makila. Kozwa te 'I am having dizzy'.

examples.translation: Nazali na makila ya kopesa.
examples.note: 'Tired' ezali ngambo, kasi te verbu. Na espanyol tozali kozwa 'estoy cansado', kasi na anglais 'I feel tired' to 'I am tired'.

examples.translation: Nazali malamu.
examples.note: Lire oyo tozali kozala na yango mbala nionso tango tozali kozwa 'How are you?' to 'How do you feel?'.

levels.label: Giving and asking about health advice
levels.translation: Kopesa na kozwa mibeko ya ntoma

examples.translation: Nani ezali na yo?
examples.note: Kozwa ya solo mpo kozwa makila oyo ezali na moto. Ezali ya solo.

examples.translation: Ozali koswana koposa.
examples.note: Kozala na 'should' + verbu na bosongi mpo kopesa mibeko. Kozwa te 'should to rest'.

examples.translation: Toma likambu oyo.
examples.note: Verbu ezali 'take' mpo na likambu, kasi te 'drink' to 'eat'.

examples.translation: Ozali koswana kosala eloko oyo te.
examples.note: 'Shouldn't' ezali ndenge ya solo ya 'should'. Tozali kozala na yango mpo kopesa mibeko ya kosala eloko te.

title: Making requests and offers / Koma mabotamisi na kosala makasi
bridge: Na espanyol, tozali kosala ba mabotamisi na imperativo to '¿Puedes...?', kasi na anglais bazali kosala ba nguya na 'Can' na 'Could' na bosembo mingi. Po kosala makasi, ba espanyol bazali koloba '¿Quieres que...?', kasi na anglais bazali kosala nguya na 'Can I...?' to 'Do you want me to...?'. Boye mpe, na anglais, 'Could you...?' ezali na bosembo mingi koleka 'Can you...?', mpe boye mpe tokoki kosala mabotamisi te na imperativo mpo ezali kokamba ntango mingi.
rule:
Po kosala ba mabotamisi na anglais na niveau A2, tozali kosala nguya na: 
- 'Can you + verbo...?' (ya molongo, mawa) 
- 'Could you + verbo...?' (na bosembo mingi na bosembo) 
- 'Would you mind + gerundio?' (na bosembo mingi, kasi ezali na bosembo). 
Po kosala makasi: 
- 'Can I + verbo...?' (Nakoki...?) 
- 'Do you want me to + verbo...?' (Oyebi ngai na kosala...?) 
- 'Would you like me to + verbo...?' (na bosembo mingi). 
Boyeka ete na anglais, verbu oyo ezali na nsima ya 'Can' to 'Could' ezali na ndakisa ya ntango ya ye moko te. Po kosala makasi, senga 'me to' na nsima ya 'want' to 'like'. Senga 'Do you want that...' lokola na espanyol te.

concept_examples.text: Can you help me with this?
Could you open the window, please?
Can I give you a hand?
Do you want me to get you a coffee?
concept_examples.translation: Oyebi ngai na kopesa yo kawa?
concept_examples.phonetic: /duː juː wɒnt miː tə ɡet juː ə ˈkɒfi/

common_error.wrong: Do you want that I help you?
common_error.correct: Do you want me to help you?
common_error.explanation: Na espanyol tozali koloba '¿Quieres que te ayude?', mpe ba étudiants bazali koyekola yango na ndenge ya 'that I'. Na anglais, ndenge ya kosala ezali 'want + persona + to + verbo', te 'that + sujeto + verbo'. Ndakisa mosusu ezali kosala nguya na 'Can I help you?' oyo ezali kokamba ntango mingi na mawa.

levels.label: Basic requests with Can
levels.translation: Ba mabotamisi ya mawa na Can

examples.original: Can you pass me the salt?
examples.translation: Nakoki kopesa ngai sel?',
examples.note: Ndakisa ya mawa na mikolo ya mobimba. 'Pass me' eleki 'pásame', kasi na 'can' ezali kokamba ntango mingi.

examples.translation: Nakoki koboma porte?
examples.note: Bazali kosala 'can' po ba mabotamisi ya molongo kati na ba nganda to ba collègues.

examples.original: Can you speak more slowly, please?
examples.translation: Nakoki koloba na bosoto mingi, boye mpe?
examples.note: Kosala 'please' na nsima po bosembo mingi.

levels.label: Polite requests with Could
levels.translation: Ba mabotamisi ya bosembo na Could

examples.translation: Boyebi kopesa ngai appel suka?
examples.note: Senga 'could' po bosembo mingi to ntango ozali koyeba motó te mawa.

examples.original: Could you bring us the menu, please?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː brɪŋ ʌs ðə ˈmenjuː pliːz/
examples.translation: Boyebi kopesa biso menu, boye mpe?
examples.note: Na ba restaurant, 'could' ezali na bosembo mingi koleka 'can'.

examples.original: Could you help me carry these bags?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː help miː ˈkæri ðiːz bæɡz/
examples.translation: Boyebi kosalisa ngai na kopesa ba sacs?
examples.note: Po kosala makasi ya mawa, senga 'could' po bosembo mingi.

levels.label: Making offers
levels.translation: Kosala makasi

examples.original: Can I get you something to drink?
examples.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡet juː ˈsʌmθɪŋ tə drɪŋk/
examples.translation: Nakoki kopesa yo likambo ya koye?
examples.note: Ndakisa ya mawa po kosala makasi, eleki 'Oyebi likambo ya koye?'

examples.original: Do you want me to help you with that?
examples.phonetic: /duː juː wɒnt miː tə help juː wɪð ðæt/
examples.translation: Oyebi ngai na kosalisa yo na yango?
examples.note: Ndenge 'want + me + to' po kosala makasi ya ndenge moko.

examples.original: Would you like me to open the window?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd juː laɪk miː tə ˈəʊpən ðə ˈwɪndəʊ/
examples.translation: Oyebi ngai na kobima fenêt're?
examples.note: Na bosembo mingi koleka 'do you want me to'. Ezali na bosembo na ba contexte ya service to na ba inconnus.

title: Expressing Ability and Possibility / Komona bokasi na bosengeli
bridge: Kuna espanyol, 'poder' ekomona bokasi mpe 'saber' ekomona kozua elongo. Kuna anglais, banani mibongo mibale na motoya 'can' (na esika oyo) mpe 'could' (na esika mosungi), kasi boye: 'could' akozua yango na bokasi oyo esalemi na esika mosungi (na ndakisa, 'Could you swim?') mpe 'be able to' ekomona na ntango 'can' akozua yango. Kuna bosengeli, 'can' mpe 'could' ekomona bosengeli ya ndenge nyonso, kasi 'may' mpe 'might' ekomona bosengeli ya ndenge moke te, oyo ezali na espanyol na ndenge moke te.
rule: Kuna kozua elongo na esika oyo, komona 'can' + motoya ya mwa ntango (na ndakisa, 'I can swim'). Na esika mosungi, kuna kozua elongo ya ndenge nyonso, komona 'could' + motoya ya mwa ntango (na ndakisa, 'I could swim when I was young'). Kuna bokasi oyo esalemi na esika mosungi (bokasi), komona 'was/were able to' (te 'could'). Kuna bosengeli, 'can' ekomona bosengeli ya ndenge nyonso (na ndakisa, 'It can rain'), 'could' ekomona bosengeli ya esika mosungi to ya kondisyonèl (na ndakisa, 'It could rain later'), 'may' mpe 'might' ekomona bosengeli ya ndenge moke te (na ndakisa, 'She may come'). Mpo na kozua elongo ya 'can', komona 'cannot' to 'can't', mpo na 'could', komona 'couldn't'. Komona 'to' na nsuka ya 'can' to 'could' te.

concept_examples.text: I can speak English and Spanish.
Could you help me, please?
concept_examples.translation: Boye ozali kokoki kosalisa ngai, boye?

concept_examples.text: She might be at home now.
concept_examples.translation: Ye azali na esika ya ndako mosika.

concept_examples.text: We were able to find the hotel after asking.
concept_examples.translation: Tokoki kozua ndako ya motel na nsuka ya kopusa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː wɜːr ˈeɪbəl tə faɪnd ðə hoʊˈtɛl ˈæftər ˈæskɪŋ/

common_error.wrong: I can to play the guitar.
common_error.explanation: Na espanyol tozua 'puedo tocar', na 'a' kaka na bangaku, mpe tokoki kokoma 'to' na nsuka ya 'can'. Kasi na anglais, 'can' ekoma na nsuka ya motoya ya mwa ntango, na 'to' te. Kosepela: can + motoya ya mwa ntango, te can + to + motoya.

levels.label: Ability in the Present
levels.translation: Bokasi na esika oyo

examples.translation: Nazali kozua kokoma likolo malamu.
examples.note: Komona 'can' mpo na kozua elongo ete ozali kozua yango. Kamba ete na espanyol tozua 'saber' to 'poder', kasi na anglais 'can' kaka.

examples.translation: Ozali kozua kokoma piano?
examples.note: Na botungi, komona 'Can' + sujet + motoya.

examples.translation: Nazali kozua kozua français te.
examples.note: Mpo na kozua elongo ya ndenge moke te, komona 'can't' (kopesa ya 'cannot').

levels.label: Ability and Possibility in the Past
levels.translation: Bokasi na bosengeli na esika mosungi

examples.original: When I was a child, I could run fast.
examples.phonetic: /wɛn aɪ wəz ə tʃaɪld, aɪ kʊd rʌn fæst/
examples.translation: Tango nazali mobali, nazali kozua kozua malamu.
examples.note: Komona 'could' mpo na bokasi ya ndenge nyonso na esika mosungi.

examples.original: I was able to finish the exam yesterday.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wəz ˈeɪbəl tə ˈfɪnɪʃ ði ɪɡˈzæm ˈjɛstərdeɪ/
examples.translation: Nazali kozua kozua examen mosika.
examples.note: Mpo na bokasi oyo esalemi na esika mosungi, komona 'was/were able to', te 'could'.

examples.translation: Mzala azali kozua kozua mosala mosika.
examples.note: Na esika mosungi, 'could' ekomona bosengeli.

levels.label: Possibility and Permission
levels.translation: Bosengeli mpe bokasi

examples.translation: Ozali kozua kozua na ndako.
examples.note: Komona 'may' mpo na kopusa to kosala bokasi ya ndenge ya kosala.

examples.translation: Mzala azali kozua kozua mosala mosika.
examples.note: Komona 'might' mpo na bosengeli ya ndenge moke te, ya ndenge ya esika oyo ezali kozua.

examples.translation: Nakoki kozua telephone na yo?
examples.note: Na anglais ya ndenge ya kosala, 'can' ekomona bokasi.

title: Talking about weather / Kozonga ntalo
bridge: Na espanyol, tozali kozonga ntalo na kumona ete 'hace calor' to 'está lloviendo', na kosalela verba 'hacer' to 'estar'. Kasi na anglais, tozali kosalela 'it' mpo na kopesa ntalo sujet: 'It is hot', 'It is raining'. Lisusu, 'weather' ezali motuna moko te, kasi tozali kolandela 'a weather' to 'weathers'.
rule:
Mpo na kozonga ntalo na anglais A2, salela bango oyo:
1. 'It is' + adjectif: It is sunny, It is cloudy, It is windy, It is cold, It is warm.
2. 'It is' + verba na gerundium mpo na makambo oyo tozali kosala: It is raining, It is snowing, It is hailing.
3. 'There is' + nom: There is a storm, There is fog, There is a rainbow.
4. 'There are' + bango mibale to mingi: There are clouds, There are showers.

Bangolo na ndakisa: 'It is hot' na 'It is cold' ezali ya solo, kasi tozali kosalela 'It's warm' na 'It's cool'. Mpo na komibela, salela 'What's the weather like?' to 'How's the weather?' (te 'How is the weather?'). Boya ete 'weather' ezali motuna moko te: kobimisa 'a weather'.

concept_examples.text: It is sunny today.
It is raining outside.
It is very cold in winter.
concept_examples.translation: Ezali na ntalo ya mbula mingi na ngonga.

concept_examples.text: There are some clouds in the sky.
concept_examples.translation: Kuna makambo ya mbula na likolo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðər ər sʌm klaʊdz ɪn ðə skaɪ/

common_error.explanation: Na espanyol tozali koloba 'el tiempo está caliente' to 'hace calor', na bato ya komonisa mingi bazali kopesa ndakisa ya solo. Kasi na anglais, mpo na kozonga ntalo, tozali kosalela 'it' mpo na sujet, te 'the weather'. Koloba 'the weather is hot' ezali kokamba malamu te; ndakisa ya solo ezali 'It is hot'. Lisusu, boya ete 'hot' ezali mpo na ntalo, te mpo na ntalo ya mobali to ya mwasi.

levels.label: Basic weather adjectives
levels.translation: Bangolo ya ntalo ya solo

examples.translation: Ezali na sole.
examples.note: Tozali kosalela 'sunny' mpo na kopesa ndakisa ya lejoli na sole. Na espanyol tozali koloba 'hace sol'.

examples.translation: Ezali na makambo ya mbula.
examples.note: 'Cloudy' tozali kosalela tango tozali na makambo ya mbula mingi. Na espanyol tozali koloba 'está nublado'.

examples.translation: Ezali na ntalo ya mbula.
examples.note: 'Windy' eleki ete ezali na ntalo ya mbula. Koyokana te na 'wind' (nom).

examples.translation: Ezali na ntalo ya mbula.
examples.note: Mpo na ntalo ya mbula. 'Cold' tozali kosalela mpo na kopesa ndakisa ya makasi to bato.

levels.label: Weather actions
levels.translation: Makambo ya ntalo

examples.translation: Ezali kosala mbula.
examples.note: Tozali kosalela 'be + -ing' mpo na makambo oyo tozali kosala. Na espanyol, 'está lloviendo'.

examples.translation: Ezali kosala mbula ya makasi.
examples.note: Mbula ya makasi ezali kosala na ntalo ya mbula mingi. 'Snow' ezali nom, 'snowing' ezali verba.

examples.translation: Ezali kosala mbula ya makasi mingi.
examples.note: 'Hail' ezali mbula ya makasi mingi. Ezali ya solo te, kasi ezali na ntina.

examples.translation: Ezali kopesa mbula.
examples.note: Ndakisa eleki ete makambo ya mbula bazali kopesa na sole ezali kosala.

levels.label: Talking about forecasts
levels.translation: Kozonga ntalo ya lelo

examples.translation: Ntalo ezali nini lelo?
examples.note: Komibela ya solo mpo na lelo. Salela 'like' na nsuka.

examples.original: It will be rainy on Friday.
examples.translation: Mbula ezali kosala na liboso.
examples.note: Salela 'will' mpo na lelo. 'Rainy' ezali adjectif, 'raining' ezali verba.

examples.original: It is going to snow tonight.
examples.translation: Mbula ya makasi ezali kosala na nsuka.
examples.note: 'Going to' ezali ya solo mpo na makambo ya lelo na elongo (makambo ya mbula, etc.).

examples.original: There will be a storm tomorrow.
examples.translation: Ezali kosala mbula ya makasi lelo.
examples.note: Salela 'there will be' mpo na kopesa ndakisa ya makambo oyo ezali kosala lelo.
